slots.name: settlement amount
slots.sentence: In December 2024, the U.S. Bureau of Prisons reached what lawyers described as a landmark agreement to pay $116 million to settle lawsuits by 103 women who said they had been sexually abused at that shuttered prison, the Federal Correctional Institution in Dublin, Calif.
